leakage_scope: Executed mutation, copy isolation, static import and exact whitelist tests only; no claim of hostile-process sandboxing
evaluator_scope: New isolated synthetic policy evaluator; not production PRAETOR certification or an independent policy-specification validation
limitations: Shared policy specification may contain common-mode errors despite separate decision code
Deadlines are cooperative measurements of bounded synchronous local functions, not preemption
Oversized input retains byte hash, not full bytes, and cannot be fully replayed from that trace
Transition references are limited to a single changed nonpressure field within the same family/source
Unclassified disagreements stop the instrument instead of becoming negative findings
